title: Imaginaryfriend's Toolkit
description: A growing collection of Foundry VTT quality-of-life modules. Currently includes: nameplate auto-fit (shrinks, wraps, or truncates token nameplates so they never overflow the token, with an optional disposition-based color mode), elevation tooltip scale/position tweaks, fading unprepared spells on D&D 5e character sheets, and miscellaneous tweaks such as a text filter for the token HUD's condition icons.
